text:
incident-bot: PAGER — HIGH: Dedicated pool 'hawthorne-prod' (tenant: hawthorne-corp) reporting GPU saturation. GPUs 8/8 at 98-100% for 12m, request queue >1200, tail latency >5s. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated/gpu-saturation :rotating_light:

alex: I'm oncall, looking now. Paging SREs.

marta: grabbing perf logs. KV cache hit-rate stable, but worker-side OOMs and enqueue latency spikes.

deepak: autoscaler logs show repeated launch failures: "quota_exceeded: GPUs per project". Cloud quota limit reached on our project in eu-west1.

jamie: hawthorne-corp is an enterprise VPC tenant with burst option in contract. Need acct signoff to allow burst capacity.

lisa: pinged ops@hawthorne-corp and their on-call (simon). Awaiting approval, told me to proceed with emergency burst for 2 hours if it gets them out of the window. :thumbsup:

alex: proposed mitigation steps — 1) enable contract burst (spin up 4 extra GPUs), 2) evict non-prod/test workloads from the cluster, 3) temporarily route heavy traffic to smaller model variant (redwood-medium) for 20% of requests, 4) apply short-term rate limit for low-priority jobs. Any objections?

marta: agree. Also recommend throttling embeddings-heavy routes for tenant if possible.

deepak: trying to enable burst nodes now. Running CLI:

```
# enable burst for tenant
rcli admin burst enable --tenant hawthorne-corp --pool hawthorne-prod --duration 120m --requested-gpus 4
```

deepak: Cloud API returned provisioning error: "driver_incompatibility: nvidia-driver-version-mismatch" on the new instances. Rolling a custom AMI with compatible driver. ETA ~12m.

alex: while deepak fixes AMI, let's apply the model fallback and evict non-prod. Commands:

```
rcli pool drain --pool hawthorne-prod --selector tag=test --force
rcli routing set-model-override --tenant hawthorne-corp --route "*" --fraction 0.2 --model redwood-medium
rcli quotas adjust --tenant hawthorne-corp --priority high --limit 1000
```

jamie: I've informed Hawthorne support channel about the fallback. They're okay with short-term quality drop.

incident-bot: NOTE — applied routing override by alex at 1768888200.

marta: after downgrade and evictions, queue dropped from ~1200 -> ~280 in 10m, tail latency down to ~1.8s. GPU util dropped to 82%.

deepak: AMI build finished, launching 4 burst nodes now. One node failed healthcheck with driver mismatch; restarting provisioning with fallback image.

alex: applying temporary rate limit to low-priority customers to reserve capacity:

```
rcli rate-limit set --scope cluster --profile low-priority --rps 50
```

ops-hawthorne: thanks team — we're seeing degraded but acceptable performance for critical flows. Please keep us posted.

lisa: customer provided written approval for the 2-hour burst. Documented in ticket RW-67891.

marta: monitoring shows sustained improvement. We'll keep burst enabled until autoscaler fully recovers or quota increase completes.

deepak: final burst nodes became healthy at 1768888812. Cluster capacity now +4 GPUs, overall util ~68%.

alex: incident-bot: marking incident as mitigated. Root-cause: cloud GPU quota and an unexpected AMI driver mismatch during automated burst provisioning.

incident-bot: RESOLVED — mitigation applied, SLOs returning to normal. Duration: ~36m from pager to stable. :white_check_mark:

jamie: next steps / action items:
- deepak: open cloud quota increase request (priority) for eu-west1 GPUs and follow up with cloud rep.
- marta: add a runbook step for AMI driver-compat checks before burst, add automated health-check rollback.
- alex: schedule a postmortem and communicate to hawthorne-corp with timeline & compensation options.
- lisa: coordinate with sales for offering dedicated reserved capacity as part of contract upsell.

marta: logging follow-up notes in incident tracker RW-67891, assigning owners.

alex: handing off to next oncall (rachel) for monitoring through the night. rachel, FYI — watch for any requeue spikes. :eyes:

rachel: ack, I'll keep an eye and I have the escalation plan.

lisa: customer replied: "Thanks for quick handling. Please share postmortem and confirm quota request"

incident-bot: closing thread (status: mitigated). Full logs and timeline: https://redwood/incidents/RW-67891/logs
